entities.name: Radix
entities.description: A sacred humming sphere of green metal at the center of the Tangle on Mirrodin, destroyed to form the Green Lacuna.

entities.name: Green Lacuna
entities.description: Site formed where the Radix was destroyed; fifth moon of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Araneas Altar
entities.description: Eight-sided shrine built by the Sylvok around the Radix to honor Lord Araneas.

entities.name: Viridian elves
entities.description: Elves who sent their honored dead to the Radix and banished unnatural machines there.

entities.name: Sylvok
entities.description: Druids of the Tangle who built the Araneas Altar.

entities.name: Heartwood Shard
entities.description: Rare exception to items that vanish on the Radix.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Tapped a large amount of mana to destroy the Kaldra Champion.

entities.name: Fifth Dawn
entities.description: Event after which metallo-organic growths sprouted.

events.summary: Glissa taps large mana to destroy the Kaldra Champion; a surge of green mana discharges through the Radix and becomes Mirrodin's fifth moon, destroying the Radix and forming the Green Lacuna.
events.quote: effectively destroying the Radix and forming the Green Lacuna in its place

events.summary: After the fifth dawn, metallo-organic growths (lamina) sprout around the lacuna.
events.quote: strange, metallo-organic growths began to sprout around and within the lacuna

events.summary: The Sylvok build the Araneas Altar around the Radix to honor Lord Araneas.
events.quote: The Sylvok built a shrine around the Radix.

relations.quote: The Radix was a site in the very center of the Tangle
